notes.title: 🎮 New Game from the Raiders of the Apocalypse Dev: One Man’s Trash
notes.content:
It’s a ridiculous, vacuum-powered junkyard adventure where you dig for trash, secrets, and maybe even your sanity. And yes... you’re looking for a lost PitCoin hard drive. (Based on a true disaster 😅)

👉 Add it to your Steam wishlist so you don’t miss the demo — coming soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3692070/One_Mans_Trash/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w3VmuwX93SM

🔥 Get ready for:
🎭 Satirical storytelling with a colorful aesthetic
🔁 A strange but satisfying gameplay loop
🕶️ A mix of dark humor, light horror, and bizarre surprises
🌀 A vacuum to upgrade, secrets to uncover, and sanity to lose

🚧 I’ve poured a lot of love (and trash) into this thing. Thanks for supporting this weird little solo dev adventure, it means the world.

notes.title: Raiders of the Apocalypse - OUT NOW! 🚀
notes.content:
The time has come, [b]Raiders of the Apocalypse[/b] is officially [b]released[/b]! Dive into abandoned bunkers, scavenge for supplies, and fight off deadly mutants as you struggle to survive. Whether you go in solo or team up with friends, every run is a fight against time, oxygen, and the horrors lurking in the dark.

🔹 Explore randomly generated bunkers
🔹 Team up with friends or go solo
🔹 Expand and upgrade your home bunker
🔹 Loot, craft, and fight to stay alive

The world is broken, but survival is in your hands. [b]Play now and see how deep you dare to go![/b]

notes.title: Raiders of the Apocalypse – Release Date Revealed!
notes.content:
The time has come, survivors! Raiders of the Apocalypse finally has a release date – mark your calendars for 14th March 2025!

Venture into the ruins of a lost world, where every trip into the depths is a battle against time, oxygen, and the horrors left behind. Loot abandoned bunkers, take on deadly mutants, and befriend the last remnants of humanity as you fight to build your own sanctuary.

💀 Explore Randomly Generated Bunkers – No two runs are the same!
🔨 Expand Your Home Bunker – Break down walls, clear debris, and make it your own.
🧟 Encounter Survivors and Mutants – Choose to aid or avoid, fight or flee.
🎮 Solo or Multiplayer – Brave the apocalypse alone or with friends.

The countdown begins now. Will you be ready to face the depths? Wishlist now and prepare for launch!
